user_prompt: We need to pull together our supplier payment terms and current commitments against what we've got coming in from our clients this quarter—basically reconcile who we owe and what we're expecting to collect so we can forecast our cash position accurately.

steps.step_name: Pull together our supplier payment terms and current financial commitments we owe

args.content:
LANDSCAPE SYSTEMS (10 visible):
- workday.hcm: HCM - compensation agents only, NO REST API for staffing data
- sap.sf: SuccessFactors HCM - REST API: EmployeeCompensationManagement:v1 (READ payroll/compensation data)
- sap.s4: ERP - MaterialReceiptInboundAPI (INBOUND REST API for goods receipt/shipment recording), Procurement agents, OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine
- sap.crm: CRM - sales/marketing agents, VendorMaterialProcurementCoordinator agent (AGENT ONLY)
- sap.ehs: Safety/health agents - SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator, IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer (analyzes incidents/trends), IncidentResponseCoordinator, ComplianceCampaignOrchestrator
- sap.ariba: Procurement - PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI (REST API for real-time PO status tracking + vendor monitoring), agents for invoice reconciliation & supplier compliance
- corp.itsm: IT service mgmt - agents ONLY (NO create API)
- emarsys.cx: CX/marketing - agents only
- my.mes: Manufacturing - ProductionQualityMonitor, BillOfMaterialsComplianceValidator, SupplierQualityComplianceOrchestrator, HazmatIncidentComplianceMonitor
- siemens.plm: PLM - EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning, BOMComplianceValidator, SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator, QualityAssuranceAndDefectPrevention
- sap.odm: Data model (entity taxonomy only)

KEY APIS:
- sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1 - REST API exposing PurchaseOrder & Vendor entities; enables monitoring POs (financial commitments) + vendor master (payment terms)
- sap.ariba:apiResource:SourceingCampaignAndAccountManagementAPI:v1 - REST API for campaigns/accounts

INVOICE RECONCILIATION:
sap.ariba:agent:VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation:v1
- Autonomously matches vendor invoices to POs and contracts using three-way matching logic
- Validates line-item quantities, pricing, and terms
- Flags exceptions: overbilling, duplicate invoices, policy violations
- Routes approved invoices for payment processing

SUPPLIER PAYMENT TERMS & COMMITMENTS:
Best resource: sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1
- Exposes PurchaseOrder (financial commitment) and Vendor (payment terms) entities
- REST API for monitoring PO status and supplier data in real-time
- Supports bulk operations for procurement integration
